page.title: Sign in to Social Income
page.description: One login for contributors, partners and program teams. We'll take you to the right place.
page.image-alt: Women carrying goods on their heads through a market street in Sierra Leone
page.quote: We are living in a world of opportunities, let's make sure we share this privilege with everyone else.

no-account.title: No account yet?
no-account.description: Make a donation and we'll create your account automatically.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account exists for {email}, we'll email you a login link shortly.
sent.hint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder.

magic-link-email.subject: Your Social Income sign-in link
magic-link-email.preview-text: Use this one-time link to sign in to Social Income.
magic-link-email.heading: Sign in to Social Income
magic-link-email.body: Click below to securely sign in to your Social Income account.
magic-link-email.security-notice: For your security, this link can only be used once.
magic-link-email.ignore-notice: If you didn't request this email, you can safely ignore it.
magic-link-email.archive: A sign-in email was sent. The one-time link is [REDACTED] in this archive.

confirm-login.title: Complete sign in
confirm-login.body: Click the button below to complete sign in.

finish-login.error-description: The link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one to sign in.

error.rate-limited: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
